card.name: Words before a person or party is dealt with
card.fires_on: Small verbs and linking words that come right before an expected person or group the subject deals with, such as sell it to, share with, believes someone, or give to. Fires on the word just before that recipient or counterpart.

modes.label: Verb before a recipient
modes.description: A verb or small adverb where the next words name who receives or is dealt with.
modes.example: "We'll just<< sell>> it to the Chinese

modes.label: Linking word before another party
modes.description: A word like 's, same, to or other that leads into a second person or thing in a relation.
modes.example: who will obtain each other<<'s>> intended.

card.writes: It pushes words about contacting, interacting and dealing with someone, such as contacts, interacts, contacting.
card.plain: It marks spots where a sentence is about to say who someone interacts with or gives something to.
